results.title: Berkeley County, South Carolina Property Search
results.snippet: The local property search is the best first stop when you need to connect an address or owner name to the official parcel, account, assessed value, and tax record. Open the listed portal below, then keep the parcel or account identifier available for any follow-up with Berkeley County Real Property Services (Assessor).

results.title: Berkeley County CAD Property Search, Records & Appraisal District
results.snippet: Berkeley County does not use a Texas-style Central Appraisal District. Use Berkeley County Real Property Services for property cards and assessment questions, the Treasurer for tax payments, and the Register of Deeds for deeds, plats, mortgages and recorded property documents.

results.title: Message from Berkeley County Real Property Services
results.snippet: Message from Berkeley County Real Property Services: DON'T WAIT TO APPLY FOR THE 4% SPECIAL ASSESSMENT! If you recently bought a new home or made changes to your deed (ex. death of an owner, added an owner, removed an owner), you need to apply for the 4% special assessment.

results.title: Berkeley County, SC Assessor Property Search and Records | AssessorSearch
results.snippet: Use the official Berkeley County Real Property Search for county ownership and parcel records when owner names are available online. Use AssessorSearch property search as a free, easy-to-use option to look up Berkeley County properties by address or APN. Where can I verify assessed value in Berkeley County?

results.title: Berkeley County Real Property Service Comparable Sales Tool
results.snippet: Acreage ranges must be numeric. Sales price ranges must be numeric. Building SQFT ranges must be numeric.
